name: 11a-hydroxytetracycline (enzymatic primary product; transient)
structure_status: STRUCTURE UNCERTAIN — transient hemiketal; decomposes non-enzymatically to poorly characterized downstream products (L01, L05)

residual_activity.class: activity loss demonstrated (downstream products; functional resistance literature)
residual_activity.detail: Hydroxylation disrupts C11-C12 beta-diketone Mg-chelating pharmacophore required for ribosome binding; downstream products inactive (Yang 2004).

safety_triage.class: LOW-EVIDENCE — absence of tox data != safe; flagged for follow-up LC-MS product work

name: 4-epitetracycline
route: abiotic C4 epimerisation (equilibrium, weakly acidic pH) — environmental transformation product
occurrence: detected with parent in waters/manure matrices (epimer equilibrium)

residual_activity.class: RETAINED (reduced) — C4 epimer keeps full ring-chelation scaffold; equilibrates back to parent

safety_triage.class: CONCERN for continued selective pressure: retains antibacterial activity hence drives AMR selection even after 'removal' of parent

residual_activity.class: RETAINED but altered (weak antibacterial; acts as competitive inhibitor of Tet(X)-family destructases)

safety_triage.class: MODERATE CONCERN — retains chelating chromophore; cytotoxicity reports in pharmacology literature; can suppress enzymatic detox (TetX inhibitor)

name: Oxidation product group (laccase/MnP route)

known_vs_predicted: KNOWN routes / individual structures partially resolved

residual_activity.class: reported antimicrobial-activity reduction for treatment effluents (assay-dependent)
